title: Generating Stable Transfection in Bodo saltans
author: Fatma Gomaa
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.s6cehaw
materials: Cells were processed for genotyping analysis to confirm plasmid integration 3 weeks post-electroporation. DNA was extracted from pools of transfected and wild cells using the Qiagen DNeasy Blood & Tissue kit.

Cells were processed for genotyping analysis to confirm plasmid integration 3 weeks post-electroporation. DNA was extracted from pools of transfected and wild cells using the Qiagen DNeasy Blood & Tissue kit.

steps.title: Electroporate cells
steps.instruction: Use a square‑wave electroporator (Nepa21, Bulldog Bio, Inc.) to electroporate B. saltans cells with the 18S‑GFP plasmid, applying one poring pulse of 200 V for 25 ms followed by five transfer pulses of 60 V for 99 ms each.

steps.title: Select transfected cells
steps.instruction: Add G418 to the culture medium to a final concentration of 1 µg ml⁻¹ 24 hours after electroporation; wash the cells and subculture into fresh selection medium every 3–4 days; monitor for emergence of G418‑resistant cells 7–9 days post‑electroporation.

steps.title: Verify integration by PCR
steps.instruction: Perform six PCR reactions on genomic DNA from the transfected cells using the primer pairs described, run the products on an agarose gel, and compare band sizes to the expected sizes shown in Figure 2.

substeps.instruction: PCR #1: primers Ribo_tag_forward & GFP_reverse – expected 800 bp band.
PCR #2: primers Neo_forward & Ribo_tag_reverse – expected 1000 bp band.
PCR #3: primers TubR & IG_forward – expected three bands (sizes not specified).
PCR #4: primers Tub_forward & IG_reverse – expected three bands (sizes not specified).
PCR #5: primers Ribo_tag_forward & Ribo_tag_reverse – wild‑type (C) cells 350 bp; transfected cells S1 and S2 show two bands at 350 bp and 2800 bp.
PCR #6: (sixth primer set mentioned in the text but specific details not provided).
